examples.arabic: الموظف كان مشغول بس ساعدني بسرعه
examples.english: The employee was busy but he helped me quickly.
examples.transliteration: el mowazzaf kan mashghool bas saaedni bseraa

examples.arabic: المكتب كتير مرتاح بس انا دايما مشغول
examples.english: The office is very comfortable but I am always busy.
examples.transliteration: al maktab kteer mertah bas ana dayman mashghool

examples.arabic: البياع كان مشغول مع ناس كتير
examples.english: The vendor was busy with many people.
examples.transliteration: El-bayya' kan mashghoul ma' nas kteer.

examples.arabic: أبي طيب وكريم دايما بيجيب أحسن شي النا حتى لو كان مشغول كتير
examples.english: My father is kind and generous; he always brings the best for us even if he is very busy.
examples.transliteration: Abī ṭayeb w karīm dāyman bījīb aḥsan shī ilnā ḥattā law kān mashghūl ktīr.
